declaration.negotiation_history_statement: The parties negotiated through confidential mediation. Because the negotiations are confidential mediation communications, this statement does not recount their substance or disclose offers and counteroffers. The resulting agreement provides a $30.5 million class fund, automatic distribution to identified class members, and a separately stated $6.5 million request for attorneys’ fees and expenses, subject to court approval. Brightline agreed not to oppose the fee request, and any amount the Court does not award will revert to the class. The agreement followed negotiations addressing both class relief and fees; I cannot represent that fees were discussed only after class relief had been agreed.
